private_rooms: Yes: for 8, 10-20, 20-30, 30+ (8+ partitioned with dividers); buyout for 50+

notes: May 2026 reviews on the page say the main shop is closing for renovation. A temporary annex opened 2026-06-23: 天ぷら新宿つな八 総本店 別館, Shinjuku 3-28-4 TRES SHINJUKU 6F/B1F, https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1304/A130401/13320520/ , score 3.04 from 26 reviews, 69 seats (B1F 34 tables; 6F 35 mostly counter), no private rooms, online reservations, closed 31 Dec and 1 Jan, budget JPY 5,000-5,999 / 2,000-2,999. Treat the 総本店 as not plannable unless it reopens before December.

name: Washoku Ukihashi (Hotel Granvia Kyoto)

private_rooms: Yes, 4 rooms for 4, 6 or 8; no buyout
reservations: Available online (phone 075-342-5527 listed but lines closed)
price: Listed JPY 6,000-7,999 / 3,000-3,999; review-based JPY 8,000-9,999 / 5,000-5,999; 15% service charge

name: Hoto Fudo Kawaguchiko Kita Honten

private_rooms: No; private use available for up to 20 / 20-50 / 50+
reservations: Since Oct 2025 only for groups of 10+, so a party of 7 walks in
notes: I picked this branch from the address alone (Kawaguchi district on the north shore). I did not measure the distance to the lake on a map. Other branches: 東恋路店 https://tabelog.com/en/yamanashi/A1903/A190303/19004418/ 3.48 from 1,345 reviews, Funatsu Higashi-koiji 2458, 1,355 m from Kawaguchiko Sta., 290 table seats, three benches with backrests, children welcome, no reservations, cash only, open year-round 11:00-20:00; it is the dome building and may suit the older parents best. 河口湖南店 https://tabelog.com/en/yamanashi/A1903/A190303/19000047/ 3.41 from 408 reviews, Funatsu 1672-2, 450 seats, 11:00-19:00, no reservations, cash only. 駅前店 unverified. Pregnancy: the hoto is fine; skip the horse sashimi (馬刺し), which is raw.

name: Kamameshi Shizuka Koen-ten
area: Noboriojicho 59-11, near Nara Park / National Museum (10 min from Kintetsu Nara)
closed: Tuesday. No New Year notice on the page
reservations: Page conflicts: details say reservations unavailable; phone section says reserve online
price: JPY 1,000-1,999 (review-based also 2,000-2,999); cards, e-money and QR accepted
notes: The Mon 4 Jan pattern fits: Koen-ten is closed only on Tuesday. The other branch, 志津香 大宮店 (https://tabelog.com/en/nara/A2901/A290101/29005137/), scores higher at 3.48 from 380 reviews and takes reservations, but it is CLOSED MONDAY and Tuesday, so it doesn't work on 4 Jan. Each pot is cooked to order (about 20 minutes, per search snippets I couldn't confirm on the page). Pregnancy: safe.

name: Akadama Honten

name: Tachigui Sushi Akira (Shimbashi)
name_ja: 立喰い寿司 あきら
area: Shimbashi 3-8-5 B1F (JR Shimbashi Karasumori exit 4 min)
closed: Wednesday. No New Year notice on the page
private_rooms: No; private use for up to 20
reservations: Page conflicts: details say unavailable; another line says reserve online. Remarks: guests admitted first-come, first-served every hour
price: JPY 10,000-14,999 (budget and review-based); also lists JPY 6,000-7,999 average; cards, e-money, QR
notes: Ranks 3rd of 89 in Tabelog's Tokyo 立ち食い寿司 ranking sorted by score, and 1st in the target areas. With 7 standing spots, the party fills the counter alone. Split into two hourly rounds, or ask about private use. The older parents and the pregnant guest would be standing, so this isn't ideal for them. Pregnancy: fresh sushi is allowed by the brief's OB rule; limit bluefin; avoid raw shellfish (oysters, ark shell, scallop raw) and anything with raw egg; ask for cooked items (anago, tamago, ebi boiled). Not on the 2025 sushi 百名店 Tokyo list.

name: Sushi Ginza Onodera Toryumon
name_ja: 鮨 銀座おのでら 登龍門
closed: Not fixed. No New Year notice on the page
hours: Mon-Fri 17:00-22:00; Sat/Sun/hol 16:00-22:00 (L.O. 21:30, last entry 21:00). Numbered tickets from 16:00 weekdays / 15:00 weekends
seats: 20 (Tabelog genre is stand-up sushi; the page does not state 'standing' in the seat field)
notes: Ranks 9th of 89 in the Tokyo 立ち食い寿司 score ranking, and 2nd in the target areas. It's dinner only, so get tickets early. Pregnancy: same rules as Akira; tuna is a focus here, so cap the bluefin. Other target-area shops seen in the ranking: すし専門ストア 赤ドヘイ 新橋店 3.50 (https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1301/A130103/13306249/), not opened. Near misses outside the target areas: 立喰鮨 となり 3.69 at Azabu-Juban, 鮨 みかた 3.67 at Tamachi, 魚河岸 山治 3.55 at Toranomon Hills, 立喰い寿司 ひろ屋 3.55 at Daimon.
